sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: TWO-STREAM CYCLONIC FLOW OVER THE CNTRL AND ERN U.S. WILL AMPLIFY THROUGH THU AS SRN STREAM DISTURBANCES NOW OVER E TX AND THE LWR MS VLY ARE OVERTAKEN BY NRN STREAM JET MAX NOW DIGGING SE ACROSS THE CNTRL PLNS. SATELLITE EXTRAPOLATION AND GUIDANCE BOTH SUGGEST THAT THE PHASING SYSTEMS WILL EVOLVE INTO CLOSED LOW OVER THE TN VLY TNGT. THIS LOW SHOULD CONTINUE E TO THE SRN APPALACHIANS EARLY THU AS THE FLOW REMAINS BROADLY ZONAL WELL UPSTREAM INTO THE E PACIFIC. AT LWR LVLS...INCREASING DVCA AHEAD OF LEAD SRN STREAM IMPULSE WILL MAINTAIN WEAK CYCLOGENESIS NOW UNDERWAY ALONG MAIN BAROCLINIC ZONE STALLED OVER THE NERN GULF. THE RESULTING LOW SHOULD REACH THE FL CSTL BEND THIS EVE...BEFORE MORE SIGNIFICANT CYCLOGENESIS OCCURS LATER TNGT AND EARLY THU NEWD ALONG THE SAME FRONT OVER THE CSTL CAROLINAS. AMPLIFICATION/EWD ADVANCE OF DEVELOPING UPR TROUGH...AND CONTINUED LOW-LVL MOISTURE RETURN...WILL LEAD TO AN INCREASING RISK FOR TSTMS LATER TODAY THROUGH TNGT OVER THE FL PENINSULA. GIVEN AN ATTENDANT INCREASE IN DEEP SHEAR...SOME OF THE STORMS COULD BECOME SVR.

sections.title: FL PENINSULA LATER TODAY THROUGH EARLY THU
sections.text: MAIN W-E STATIONARY FRONT SHOULD BECOME BETTER-DEFINED ACROSS NRN FL TODAY AS LOW-LVL CONFLUENCE AND SFC HEATING DIFFERENTIAL PERSIST E OF DEVELOPING NE GULF SFC WAVE. AT THE SAME TIME...EXISTING SHALLOWER BOUNDARY/WARM FRONT NOW EXTENDING FROM THE E CNTRL GULF SEWD ACROSS S FL SHOULD FURTHER DISSIPATE...ALLOWING RICHER MARITIME AIR TO SPREAD NWD ACROSS THE SRN HALF OF THE FL PENINSULA /ESPECIALLY OVER CSTL SECTIONS/. STRENGTHENING/MOISTENING LOW-LVL CONFLUENT FLOW AHEAD OF AMPLIFYING UPR SYSTEMS...AND LOW-LVL UPLIFT ALONG COLD FRONT EXTENDING SW FROM NE GULF SFC WAVE...SHOULD SUPPORT INCREASING COVERAGE/INTENSITY OF STORMS ALREADY PRESENT IN THE ERN GULF. ADDITIONAL BROKEN BANDS OF STORMS MAY FORM AHEAD OF THE EXISTING ACTIVITY THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TNGT. WITH PW LIKELY TO INCREASE TO AROUND 1.50 INCHES...SFC DEWPOINTS RISING WELL INTO THE 60S F...AND 700 MB WSW FLOW INCREASING TO AOA 40 KTS...SETUP COULD FOSTER THE DEVELOPMENT OF EMBEDDED SMALL LEWPS/BOWS CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO BY EARLY TNGT...ESPECIALLY ALONG AND S OF STNRY FRONT OVER WRN AND NRN PARTS OF THE PENINSULA. THIS THREAT SHOULD SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE PENINSULA LATER TNGT/E

sections.title: FL PENINSULA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE INITIAL SURFACE CYCLONE JUST S OF THE FL PANHANDLE WILL DEVELOP EWD ALONG THE TIGHTENING BAROCLINIC ZONE ACROSS N FL AND THEN NEWD JUST OF THE SE ATLANTIC COAST. S OF THE FRONT...LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS SPREADING NWD INTO S/CENTRAL FL AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM...RESULTING IN SUBSTANTIAL DESTABILIZATION. IT APPEARS THAT THE INITIAL CONVECTION WILL BE SCATTERED ALONG A CONFLUENCE BAND ACROSS SE FL WITHIN THE CORRIDOR OF RICHEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. PER THE 18Z MFL SOUNDING...VEERING WIND PROFILES IN THE LOW LEVELS WITH SOME SPEED INCREASES ALOFT COULD SUPPORT A SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH A MARGINAL DAMAGING/BRIEF TORNADO WIND RISK THIS AFTERNOON. LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT...A WELL-DEFINED PRE-FRONTAL BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE INLAND...REACHING THE TAMPA BAY AREA NEAR 21Z AND CONTINUING ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF CENTRAL/S FL THROUGH TONIGHT. STRENGTHENING LOW-MIDLEVEL WSWLY FLOW WITH THE APPROACH OF THE PRIMARY SRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASING RISK FOR ORGANIZED/BOWING SEGMENTS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS. A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...PRIMARILY WHERE STORMS INTERACT WITH THE BAROCLINIC ZONE AND WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE ENHA

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE FL PENINSULA THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT BUT A TORNADO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE MCD AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH IN THE MS VALLEY WITH A LEAD SHORTWAVE EXTENDING SWD ACROSS THE ERN GULF OF MEXICO. AT THE SFC...A 1008 MB LOW IS LOCATED ABOUT 130 STATUTE MILES SOUTH OF TALLAHASSEE FL WITH A WELL-DEVELOPED 40 TO 55 KT LOW TO MID-LEVEL JET CO-LOCATED WITH THE SFC LOW. A SQUALL-LINE IS LOCATED TO THE SOUTHEAST OF THE JET FEATURE AND IS MOVING TOWARD FL PENINSULA WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 60S F. THE LINE IS PROJECTED TO MOVE INTO THE TAMPA BAY AREA IN THE 21Z TO 22Z TIMEFRAME. A FORWARD SPEED OF LINE 30 TO 35 KT ALONG WITH SOME INTENSIFICATION SHOULD RESULT IN A WIND DAMAGE THREAT IN WRN AND CNTRL FL THIS AFTERNOON. AN ISOLATED TORNADO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT ON THE LEADING EDGE ASSOCIATED WITH BOWING SEGMENTS. MORE ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP ACROSS SCNTRL FL WHERE MODERATE INSTABILITY IS LOCATED ALONG WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S F. THESE STORMS COULD ALSO HAVE A POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS IN THE FORM OF WET DOWNBURSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF STORMS WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF FL THROUGH EVENING WITH A MARGINAL WIND AND HAIL THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES TO MOVE QUICKLY EWD ACROSS CNTRL FL...WITH NERN PART OF THE LINE INTERSECTING A COLD FRONT WHICH WAS SAGGING SLOWLY SWD. THIS BOUNDARY COULD GIVES STORMS A BOOST AS THEY CROSS IT...BUT THE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO BE GUSTY WINDS AND SMALL HAIL AS WINDS QUICKLY VEER WITH OUTFLOW. TO THE S...OTHER STORMS HAVE FORMED AHEAD OF THE LINE OVER WHERE GREATER DESTABILIZATION OCCURRED DURING THE DAY. DESPITE A WIND PROFILE THAT WOULD APPEAR TO FAVOR SUPERCELLS...STORMS ARE FORWARD PROPAGATING IN A NEWD DIRECTION...LIKELY DUE TO MARGINAL BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE QUALITY PER XMR 21Z SOUNDING AND GPS PWAT ONLY AROUND 1.25 INCHES WHICH WOULD FAVOR COOLER OUTFLOW. STILL...A FEW CORES ARE PRODUCING HAIL WITH COLD PROFILES ALOFT. A MARGINAL WIND AND HAIL THREAT SHOULD THUS PERSIST THIS EVENING BEFORE THE MAIN LINE CLEARS THE E COAST. ..JEWELL.. 02/12/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD GRADUALLY WANE THIS EVENING...AND NO FURTHER WATCHES ARE EXPECTED. A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH WATCH EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THAT THE STRONGEST ACTIVITY HAS MOVED OFFSHORE THE FT. PIERCE AREA WITH MORE MEAGER STORMS TO THE SW WHERE RATHER WEAK STORMS EXIST. OUTFLOW WITH THE SRN LINE WILL LIKELY CREATE GUSTY WINDS...BUT THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE LOW. ..JEWELL.. 02/13/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
